site.name: Where They Went
site.tagline: Global forced displacement data — citable, downloadable, shareable.
site.ogAlt: World map coloured by the number of forcibly displaced people per country
page.compare.desc: Compare refugee, asylum-seeker, IDP and stateless figures for up to three countries side by side, 1951 to today — same sources, same definitions, downloadable and citable.
site.description: Interactive world map of refugees, asylum-seekers, internally displaced and stateless people by country and year, with sources, as-of dates and permanent links. Data: UNHCR, IDMC, UN WPP.
view.asylum.help: Numbers are counted in the country of asylum (where people are now).
view.origin.help: Numbers are counted by country of origin (where people fled from).
